title: IIT Madras Pravartak Opens Free Online Training for Students in Classes 7-12 and Teachers
excerpt: Free live online cohorts from November 2026 to January 2027 cover AI, electric vehicles and entrepreneurship for students, and career counselling, leadership and classroom management for teachers.
body:
• IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies Foundation, in partnership with BodhBridge Education, has opened registrations for free online live training for school students, teachers and educators.
  • Students in Classes 7 to 12 can study AI fundamentals, electric vehicles and future mobility, entrepreneurship, design thinking and innovation.
  • Teachers and educators can take career counselling certification, leadership development, and classroom management and student engagement programmes.
  • Training runs in monthly cohorts from November 2026 to January 2027 and is free; an IIT Madras Pravartak certificate is optional — register at bodhbridge.iitmpravartak.org.in.

IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies Foundation has launched free online live training programmes in future-ready skills for school students, teachers and educators, in partnership with BodhBridge Education. Registrations are open for the November 2026 to January 2027 cycle, according to the foundation.

The programmes are aimed at students in Classes 7 to 12, and are designed to connect classroom learning with practical applications in emerging technologies. More than 45,000 teachers have already benefited from the foundation's free training programmes, according to the organisers.

What students can study

For school students, the courses cover artificial intelligence (AI) fundamentals, electric vehicles and future mobility, entrepreneurship, design thinking and innovation. The sessions combine live online teaching with case studies and practical activities intended to develop problem-solving, creativity, communication and innovation skills, the foundation said.

Training will be delivered by experts from the IIT Madras alumni network, the startup ecosystem and industry. While the live training itself is free, participants who want formal recognition can opt for certification from IIT Madras Pravartak.

What is on offer for teachers

For teachers, educators and educational institutions, the programmes include career counselling certification training, a leadership development programme for educators, and classroom management and student engagement. The teacher programmes are intended to strengthen teaching practice and help educators take on leadership and guidance roles in their institutions.

Dhanalakshmi Sampath, Manager of the Digital Skills Academy at IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies Foundation, said the initiative aimed to bridge the gap between classroom education and industry requirements by building skills in AI, financial literacy and entrepreneurship, according to The News Trust report of the announcement.

The monthly-cohort structure matters for schools trying to fit the training around term schedules: a teacher or student who cannot join in November can enter in December or January without waiting for a new annual intake, according to the programme description. The courses are delivered live online, rather than as recorded-only material, with practical activities built into the sessions.

Who is behind it, and how to apply

IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies Foundation is a Section 8 company hosting the Technology Innovation Hub on Sensors, Networking, Actuators and Control Systems under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems at IIT Madras. BodhBridge Education is a learning platform operated by IIT Madras alumni for students, teachers and parents.

Interested students, teachers and educators can register through the official BodhBridge registration portal. Courses will run in monthly cohorts from November 2026 to January 2027, so applicants who miss one cohort can join a later one in the same cycle.

For families in India and in the diaspora whose children are in Classes 7 to 12, the student track offers a no-fee way to sample AI, electric mobility and entrepreneurship topics from an IIT Madras-linked programme before committing to longer courses.
